summary: Consolidated inspector and changes CSS into the Unity and Git extension packages, removing obsolete styles from the app, then renamed Unity-prefixed protocol symbols (UnityStatus/UnityOpenProjectResult) to project-agnostic equivalents (ProjectStatus/ProjectOpenResult) across the protocol, agent-client, websocket, fixtures, and tests.
decisions: Move inspector-parts CSS into the Unity extension by writing unity.css in the Unity package and importing it from UnityPanel.svelte, wrapping EditorPanel in a [data-ui='unity-status-panel'] container.
Delete apps/app/src/styles/inspector-parts/activity.css and remove its import from inspector.css.
Delete apps/app/src/styles/diagnostics.css and remove its import from apps/app/src/app.css.
Consolidate changes CSS (summary.css + tree.css) into a single git.css inside the Git extension package and import it from ChangesPanel.svelte.
Delete apps/app/src/styles/changes.css and the apps/app/src/styles/changes-parts directory.

Tag Unity-prefixed protocol symbols (unityStatusSchema/UnityStatus, unityOpenProjectResultSchema/UnityOpenProjectResult) as @deprecated aliases of projectStatusSchema/ProjectStatus and projectOpenResultSchema/ProjectOpenResult, and migrate imports/usages to the non-Unity names.
Add a runtime pass in the web extension installer that removes stale <style> tags keyed by data-gizmo-extension-style when their extension is no longer loaded.
errors: Edit to UnityPanel.svelte failed with 'Could not find edits[0]' because the oldText used a tab-indented import while the file uses two-space indentation; retried with the matching two-space indentation and succeeded.
